en.topic_title: ‘I am not important’: Security chief defends staying in post following Wang Fuk Court fire inquiry
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong’s security chief has said that his duty to society, the city, and the country outweighs his personal interests, after facing questions over his political accountability for last year’s fatal Tai Po fire.



Secretary for Security Chris Tang. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.
